hypotheses.latent_object: F(z)=s(z) for an uninterpreted single-variable function s
hypotheses.reconstruction_rule: Recover G0002 by substituting z=p in F(z)=s(z); recover G0003 by substituting z=q in F(z); recover G0001 as the first Newton divided difference of F at the nodes [p,q]: (F(p)-F(q))/(p-q).
required_assumptions: p and q are distinct or p-q is treated as an invertible symbolic denominator
s is an uninterpreted single-variable function
hypotheses.scientific_rationale: All three catalog expressions are generated from the same uninterpreted single-variable latent function s by evaluating it at the symbolic nodes p and q and by forming its first divided difference at those nodes.
